description: Subtraction-first engineering for any coding task. Use when writing, fixing, refactoring, reviewing, or designing code; when choosing dependencies; or whenever the user asks for minimalist, less code, simplest thing, YAGNI, or complains about bloat. Prefer deletion, existing code, stdlib, and native platform features before new code. Default level: full.
